requirement.original: Restructure the travel-planner memory files to implement a proper content-source policy with China/international distinction. feedback_no_gaode_for_content.md was generated from one China-specific incident (Beijing-Lijiang-Dali trip rednote rate-limit event) but is phrased as a universal rule for ALL trips. User's exact corrected policy (verbatim): 中国大陆行程：小红书主力，高德仅用于坐标/路线（venue 已选定后）/ 国际行程：无高德禁令，无强制小红书，用当地权威/社交源 → 国外统一使用 google map / 小红书限流时：暂停上报，绝不 fallback 到 POI 搜索. Additionally user_jade_infj.md applies Jade's INFJ preferences to ALL trips universally — but should only apply to couple trips where Jade is a traveler.
requirement.clarified: 1) Rewrite feedback_no_gaode_for_content.md (rename to policy_content_source.md) as a two-section geography-conditional policy (China / International) with rate-limit sub-note inside China section. 2) Add couple-trips-only scope qualifier to user_jade_infj.md. 3) Update MEMORY.md index entries. 4) Add China/international research branch to accommodation.md Tasks section (all peer agents already have this; accommodation is missing it).
requirement.what: Replace universal gaode-ban memory file with geography-scoped content-source policy; add trip-scope guard to INFJ preferences file; patch one agent file's missing research branch
requirement.why: Cross-trip contamination: a future Paris trip agent reading the current universal ban would incorrectly believe rednote is mandatory and gaode is forbidden for international trips. INFJ preferences should not affect solo trips where Jade is not traveling.
